title: This Traffic Stop Went from 0 to 100 REALLY Fast
description:
A Nebraska police officer pulled over a woman after noticing her car’s license plate tags were expired. When he asked Deann Karpowich if she knew, she defiantly stated she decided she was “done paying taxes” and sick of getting "robbed” by the local government. When the officer discovered Karpowich also failed to pay her vehicle insurance, things escalated quickly. Karpowich was charged with obstructing an officer. Her case is currently pending.
